# SkyPrep

> > Award-winning learning management system (LMS) for employee, customer, and partner training with integrated course creation, collaboration, and compliance features.

SkyPrep is a comprehensive online training platform offering an integrated suite of products including LMS, course creation studio, collaboration tools, and prebuilt course libraries. The platform serves organizations across employee onboarding, compliance training, customer enablement, and partner education with enterprise-grade security and analytics.

## Key Topics

- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Course Creation & SCORM
- Learner Engagement & Gamification
- Reporting & Analytics
- Enterprise Security (SOC 2, GDPR)
- Artificial Intelligence
- White-label Customization
- Integrations (SAML, Active Directory, HR/CRM)
- Virtual Classroom
- Compliance Training
- Employee Onboarding
- Multi-tenant Hierarchies
- Workflow Automation
- Mobile Learning
- User Management

## Products & Overview

- [SkyPrep Homepage](https://skyprep.com): SkyPrep homepage showcasing award-winning LMS for employee, customer, and partner training.
- [Products](https://skyprep.com/products): Overview of SkyPrep's product suite including LMS, Studio, Unity, and Course Library.
- [SkyPrep LMS](https://skyprep.com/products/skyprep-lms): SkyPrep LMS product page with SCORM compliance, analytics, and security features.
- [SkyPrep Studio](https://skyprep.com/products/skyprep-studio): SkyPrep Studio course creation tool with AI-powered content, quizzes, and SCORM export.
- [SkyPrep Unity](https://skyprep.com/products/skyprep-unity): SkyPrep Unity collaboration platform for team learning and knowledge sharing.
- [SkyPrep Library](https://skyprep.com/products/skyprep-library): SkyPrep Library prebuilt courses for compliance training with content partners.

## Core Features

- [Features Overview](https://skyprep.com/features): Comprehensive SkyPrep features including engagement, analytics, security, and integrations.
- [Learner Engagement](https://skyprep.com/lms/features/learner-engagement): SkyPrep learner engagement features with gamification and personalized learning paths.
- [Course Creation](https://skyprep.com/lms/features/course-creation): SkyPrep course creation tools with SCORM support and AI-powered course builder.
- [Reporting & Analytics](https://skyprep.com/lms/features/reporting-and-analytics): SkyPrep reporting and analytics dashboards for training tracking and ROI measurement.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://skyprep.com/lms/features/artificial-intelligence): SkyPrep AI features for course creation, content generation, and assessments.

## Administration & Management

- [User Management](https://skyprep.com/lms/features/user-management): SkyPrep user management with role-based access and bulk enrollment capabilities.
- [Workflow Automation](https://skyprep.com/lms/features/workflow-automation): SkyPrep workflow automation for auto-enrollment, notifications, and compliance tracking.
- [White-label Customization](https://skyprep.com/lms/features/customization): SkyPrep white-label LMS with brand customization and custom domain support.
- [Multi-Tenant/Sub-Platform Hierarchies](https://skyprep.com/lms/features/multi-tenant-sub-platform-hierarchies): SkyPrep multi-tenant hierarchies for enterprise content distribution and portal branding.

## Enterprise & Integration

- [Security](https://skyprep.com/lms/features/security): SkyPrep security with SOC 2 Type II, TLS encryption, and GDPR compliance.
- [Integrations](https://skyprep.com/lms/features/integrations): SkyPrep integrations with SAML, Active Directory, HR and CRM systems.
- [Virtual Classroom](https://skyprep.com/virtual-classroom): SkyPrep virtual classroom with Zoom, GotoMeeting, and BigBlueButton integrations.
